xBRIEFInfo.description: Probe story: Windows controlling-terminal path for operator mint, bound to #3596 successor lean after the r+ ship (PR 3605) was falsified.

plan.title: win32 controlling-terminal probe for operator mint (#3596 leftover)

narratives.Description: Remaining #3596 work is the blocking probe story only. Halt before any product edit until a real-console diagnostic of CONIN$, the Windows device-namespace CONIN$ path, and CON (each with open flags r and r+) is posted on the issue. Then implement exactly one path from that table. Dry-run is out of this story.
narratives.Origin: GitHub issue #3596. Next-build contract is successor lean 5386347944 plus verified-claims table 5386362218 plus synthesis 5386364772. Do not implement against 5383538006. Completed xBRIEF 2026-08-21-3596 (PR 3605) is record of the r+ ship, not the next-build contract (#3383).
narratives.Overview: Master still opens bare CONIN$ with r+ (PR 3605). Real-console diagnostic (operator PowerShell at C:\Repos\deft\directive): bare CONIN$ r and r+ FAIL ENOENT; Windows device-namespace CONIN$ path r and r+ OPEN; CON r and r+ FAIL ENOENT. One path: that device-namespace path with open flag r+. Probe error stays refuse mint. A successful open is device present only. Keep #3110 factors. Stay out of #3597 / #3438 fence.
narratives.UserStory: As a Windows operator, I want mint to find a controlling terminal that actually opens on a real console, so the r+ leftover does not keep mint unreachable.
narratives.When: When the six-row real-console diagnostic is on #3596, the win32 probe uses exactly one path and flag from that table, open errors refuse mint, a successful open means device present only, #3110 env-marker TTY --confirm and typed-phrase gates stay, a regression test locks the chosen path, and CHANGELOG has an Unreleased line. Issue close also needs a Windows operator mint E2E; the PR uses Refs #3596 until that mint is on the thread.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Bind 5386347944 + 5386362218 + 5386364772. Diagnostic posted from real PowerShell (not agent-pipe): bare CONIN$ and CON both ENOENT for flags r and r+; Windows device-namespace CONIN$ path OPEN for both flags. One path: that device-namespace path. Open flag r+ (r also opened; r+ kept so probe and phrase-read share one flag). Error on open = refuse mint (fail-closed, 5386342482). Successful open = device present only. Do not amend completed 2026-08-21-3596 xBRIEF. Do not implement dry-run / --explain. Do not implement #3597 or #3438. Do not weaken #3110. PR Refs #3596 until mint E2E is recorded; mint is an issue-close gate, not an agent-pipe check.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Diagnostic is on #3596. 2. controllingTerminalPath win32 returns the Windows device-namespace CONIN$ path, not bare CONIN$. 3. controllingTerminalOpenFlag win32 stays r+. 4. Regression test locks that path and flag. 5. CHANGELOG Unreleased. 6. Refs #3596. 7. Drive to merge-ready. 8. Human mint E2E on a real console before issue close.
narratives.OriginDivergence: Completed 2026-08-21-3596 xBRIEF delivered PR 3605 (r+). This file is a new proposed contract for leftover probe work after reopen 5374602077 and accepted synthesis 5386364772. Comments 5386398500 (operator verb) and 5386459826 (real-console diagnostic table) are process/diagnostic, not a spec change; D12 bump 2026-08-23T16:30:00Z after those posts. Issue body still describes the falsified read-only theory.

items.title: Six-row real-console diagnostic on #3596 before any product edit

narrative.When: When product code is edited, #3596 already has a real-console table for CONIN$, the Windows device-namespace CONIN$ path, and CON, each with open flags r and r+, and agent-pipe ENOENT was not used as that record.
narrative.Acceptance: When product code is edited, #3596 already has a real-console table for CONIN$, the Windows device-namespace CONIN$ path, and CON, each with open flags r and r+, and agent-pipe ENOENT was not used as that record.

items.title: Win32 probe uses exactly one path and flag from that table

narrative.When: When defaultHasControllingTerminal and defaultReadInteractiveConfirm run on win32, they open the single path and flag chosen from the posted diagnostic, not a guessed alternative.
narrative.Acceptance: When defaultHasControllingTerminal and defaultReadInteractiveConfirm run on win32, they open the single path and flag chosen from the posted diagnostic, not a guessed alternative.

items.title: Open error refuses mint; successful open is device present only

narrative.When: When the controlling-terminal open throws, mint is refused. When it succeeds, that is device present only, not an extra human-presence factor beyond the existing #3110 gates.
narrative.Acceptance: When the controlling-terminal open throws, mint is refused. When it succeeds, that is device present only, not an extra human-presence factor beyond the existing #3110 gates.

items.title: Regression test locks the chosen win32 path and flag

narrative.When: When pnpm exec vitest run packages/cli/src/human-presence-mint.test.ts and packages/cli/src/human-presence-mint.open-flag.test.ts pass, tests lock the chosen win32 path and open flag.
narrative.Acceptance: When pnpm exec vitest run packages/cli/src/human-presence-mint.test.ts and packages/cli/src/human-presence-mint.open-flag.test.ts pass, tests lock the chosen win32 path and open flag.

narrative.When: When refuseNonInteractiveMint is read, env-marker, TTY, --confirm, and typed phrase mint are still required and none of them is weakened or skipped.
narrative.Acceptance: When refuseNonInteractiveMint is read, env-marker, TTY, --confirm, and typed phrase mint are still required and none of them is weakened or skipped.

narrative.Acceptance: When CHANGELOG Unreleased is read, it has a brief line for the leftover Windows controlling-terminal probe.
